Refresh package lists before installing packages.

## Inputs

No artifact inputs.

## Scheduling

<dl class="reference-list">

<dt>

Priority

</dt>
<dd>

`900000`

</dd>

<dt>

Dependencies

</dt>
<dd>

`pkg-cleanup`

</dd>

</dl>

Higher priorities run first within the selected recipe set unless `before` or
`after` constraints require otherwise. Dependencies include other recipes
without ordering them.

## Behavior

Runs early and includes pkg-cleanup as a dependency, so temporary package
metadata is removed after the other recipes finish.

## Example

For example, add the recipe to a layer derived from a compatible base:

```toml
recipes = ["core/pkg-update"]
```
